tileset_stage2.note: same layout as tileset_stage1: folder ground (4-bit edges), selected-row one-way platform, spikes reused

ok_button.note: 40x20 signal button (Win95 OK), bottom pivot on the plate

tree_row_block.note: 40x40 signal block: folder tree rows expand/collapse

drop_zone.note: 40x20 button pressed only by a file box; idle = marching dashed outline

scroll_track.note: 40x40 elevator rail, tiles vertically (Tiled draw mode); decoration only

shortcut_platform.note: 40x20 falling platform: play shake, then let it fall; collider top 10px

error_dialog.note: 48x40 turret, faces right, muzzle at (46,25). Rotate/flip for other directions

mouse_trap.note: 40x20 draggable hazard (spike rules); play snap when the player touches it

hidden_block.note: 40x40 hidden folder area; or fade the Tilemap colour alpha with the same look

spider_leg_upper.note: 150x14 upper leg. Pivot (0,7) goes on a body socket; knee at (149,7)

spider_leg_lower.note: 250x12 lower needle leg. Pivot (0,6) goes on the knee; stab point = tip (249,6). Sample standing angles (deg, screen clockwise) upper/lower: (-165,119) (-148,90) (-32,89) (-15,58); stab = raise lower to about -15 then drop

spider_thread.note: 4x40 silk thread, tiles vertically (Tiled) for descending

bug_enemy.note: 40x24 left-right patrol bug (spider family: black silhouette, red LED eyes, scanline noise, screen-tear on frames 1/3). Faces right, flip for left. Bottom pivot (20,23). death = pixel shatter, last frame then destroy

spider_body.note: 160x96 silhouette body with scanline noise; glitch = screen-tear frame to flash occasionally. Leg sockets (pixel): [(58, 60), (72, 64), (88, 66), (104, 66)]. Pivot = centre
